crossRefs.note: “I have given to you all the best of the oil, all the best of the vintage, and of the grain, the first fruits of them…

translations.web: Out of all your gifts, you shall offer every wave offering to Yahweh, of all its best parts, even the holy part of it.’
translations.bsb: You must present the offering due the LORD from all the best of every gift, the holiest part of it.’
translations.kjv: Out of all your gifts ye shall offer every heave offering of the LORD, of all the best thereof, even the hallowed part
translations.asv: Out of all your gifts ye shall offer every heave-offering of Jehovah, of all the best thereof, even the hallowed part thereof out of it.
